entries.cycles_rule: vs ot_hbm_idx_rootctl_static (zero-latency share): INDEX (SW quadrant-0 operand reader face) requests +1 (index_rq pin register) and responses +1 (vm_rr pin register): round trip +2, the SW reader must capture at n+12 (ot_hbm_idx_vm_static RT_EXTRA 4 = shell VM_RT_EXTRA 4; the shared idx_op master has 2). ARGMAX +0 (request pin register +1 and vm_rr pin register +1 absorbed by the 2-stage OR tree that replaces the 4-edge merge chain: r2 timeline rq +1 / writes +6 / done +7 unchanged, path bench offsets identical). TOPK: go +1 (command pin registers), every row +1 (engine RT_EXTRA 1: capture n+9), writes at the port +1 (cq pin register; engine ACK 13), done/fault/busy +1: per record requests of row r +1+r, writes +3+r, done +m+3, illegal-descriptor fault +2. fault +1, share_fault +1, ingest_v +0 (predicted from sel_op, SEL_LAT 4 = the selector's pin/core/out edges; selected_v mismatch -> sticky root fault), sel/link/done +0.
entries.applies: INDEX: +2 per SW operand read round trip (streamed; once per pass start); TOPK: +(m+3) per record (m rows); ARGMAX: 0. Compiler: tools/hbm_idx_static_calendar.py PIN table (SW operand reader VM_RT_EXTRA 4; TOPK go/row/ACK offsets as above).
